response.sql:
WITH per_race_name AS (
  SELECT races.name AS race_name,
         SUM(results.points) AS total_points,
         AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
), threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total_points
  FROM per_race_name
), kept AS (
  SELECT p.total_points, p.average_laps, t.average_total_points
  FROM per_race_name AS p
  CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
  WHERE p.total_points > t.average_total_points
)
SELECT SUM(total_points) AS sum_total_points,
       AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_race_name_average_laps,
       AVG(total_points - average_total_points) AS average_excess_points
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct races.name is one group, so races with the same name in different seasons are combined; each resulting name has equal weight in the threshold and average-laps calculation.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each individual race as a group, distinguishing repeated race names across seasons by raceId, then group those race totals by name only for the requested output if needed.
